description: CALL THIS for explicit lookups: "tracks by X", "downtempo around 90 bpm", "songs titled...". Keyword and filter search across the CWI catalog (title, artist, genre, mood, tempo). Use semantic_search instead if the user describes a feeling. Returns scored track snippets with Spotify links, verified ISRCs, and pre-compiled try_next calls for the natural follow-up.

q.description: Search keywords, e.g. "cyberpunk rap" or "dark cinematic". Truncated at 500 characters.

name: search_catalog

outputSchema.description: search_catalog response: scored track snippets plus pre-compiled try_next calls.

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

new_release_spotlight.description: Active pre-release spotlight: title, artist, drop date, presave URL, ISRC.

items.description: Track snippet (list views carry a snippet, not the full prose description).

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.

purpose.description: Why this call is the natural next step.
